title: Predictive Guardian Intelligence
objective: Detect disk pressure, runaway growth, and structural anomalies using local evidence without acquiring authority.

stories.title: Pressure state model
stories.outcome: Define GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED from free space, budgets, growth velocity, reclaimability, and active workload.
acceptance_criteria: Pressure is deterministic from inputs and independently testable.
Pressure does not change authority by itself.

stories.title: Growth velocity and forecast
stories.outcome: Estimate provider/project growth rate and conservative time-to-pressure forecasts.
acceptance_criteria: Sparse/noisy history produces insufficient-data rather than false precision.

stories.title: Behavioral baseline anomaly detection
stories.outcome: Build local baselines and flag statistically/heuristically unusual growth without content inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Anomaly score is explanatory and never directly destructive.

stories.title: Structural anomaly detection

blocked_by.summary: Round-2 independent review reproduced that the new provider-capability authority function is optional: the same public AuthorityInputs reach Autopilot through the pre-existing public effective_authority API after a real layout-drift finding reaches Observe through the new bridge. LayoutDriftFinding's public fields and the public compute_effective_authority API provide further ways to discard or omit the cap. This is the second failure of the current approach (round 1: no consumer; round 2: optional/bypassable consumer). Per the owner's two-round limit, no third patch-and-repeat round is authorized. An owner-level ADR/scope decision must define a mandatory, non-forgeable provider-capability authority boundary and a new work item must own its implementation.

stories.outcome: Detect session explosion, unexpected giant files, orphan growth, and provider layout drift.
stories.risk_reclassification_note: Declared CR2 at planning time; raised to CR4 at commit time (round-1 repair) because the change adds ProviderCapabilityAuthority as the ninth wired constraint in rust/crates/cancellai-safety/src/authority.rs - the CR4-floor safety-kernel path (project/risk_floors.json: 'rust/crates/cancellai-safety/src/*') - and a matching cancellai-guardian bridge that reaches it. The addition is opt-in/additive (a new function, not a change to an existing caller's behavior) but it is still an authority-boundary decision, matching this project's own precedent (E12-S03) for raising a declared level once a change actually lands inside the one mutation/authority-boundary seam rather than merely calling it.
acceptance_criteria: Layout drift can downgrade provider capabilities automatically.
Structural signals reference concrete observed evidence.
